title: She hunted the monster that stole her dragon Sintel #shorts
description: Sintel travels through harsh blizzards and endless lands to find her stolen pet dragon. After years of searching, she finally corners the monster in a dark subterranean cave. A devastating discovery changes everything she fought for.
attribution_block: Source: "Sintel" by Blender Foundation (2010), CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Original: https://durian.blender.org/sharing/. Narration, selection, editing, and commentary created for this channel. Narration generated with text-to-speech.

beats.narration: A lone traveler collapses on a frozen mountain while hunting the monster that stole her pet dragon.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel trekking through heavy snow carrying a spear before collapsing on ice.

beats.narration: Look at her worn clothing and frozen skin, showing how long she has survived out in the extreme cold.
beats.visual_cue: Close-up of Sintel lying unconscious in the snow covered in frost.

beats.narration: An Old Man rescues her from the blizzard and gives her warm soup inside his quiet shelter.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel sipping soup from a wooden bowl near a warm fire while talking to the Old Man.

beats.narration: Sintel recalls finding an injured baby dragon named Scales and wrapping a tight bandage around his bleeding wing.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel tying a white bandage onto tiny dragon Scales' injured wing.

beats.narration: Pay close attention to that wing bandage because it becomes the most important detail in her whole life.
beats.visual_cue: Scales playing happily with Sintel while displaying the wing bandage.

beats.narration: Everything changes when a massive adult dragon dives from the clouds and snatches Scales into the sky.
beats.visual_cue: A giant winged monster grabbing Scales in its claws and flying away.

beats.narration: The terrified girl watches helplessly as the giant creature carries her pet far beyond the horizon.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel reaching up toward the sky as the giant dragon disappears into the clouds.

beats.narration: Driven by revenge, she marches across grassy plains, rocky cliffs, and frozen mountains to find the beast.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel walking through tall grass fields and over rugged mountain ridges.

beats.narration: Notice how her hair grows longer and her boots wear out, proving her search lasted for many years.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel trekking through snowy cliffs looking visibly older and more weathered.

beats.narration: She enters a subterranean cave filled with bioluminescent blue crystals and massive dragon nests.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel stepping carefully into a dark glowing blue cavern holding her spear.

beats.narration: A colossal black dragon emerges from the dark, prompting Sintel to draw her sharp spear for battle.
beats.visual_cue: A gigantic dark dragon rising from the nest and growling at Sintel.

beats.narration: She dodge-rolls under the monster's sharp claws and strikes a fatal blow into its chest.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel leaping forward and stabbing her spear into the giant dragon.

beats.narration: Look at the scar on the dying monster's wing right here, revealing the tragic truth before she does.
beats.visual_cue: Close-up on the healed bandage scar on the dying dragon's wing.

beats.narration: Horrified, Sintel realizes the giant beast she just slaughtered was actually her beloved pet Scales.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel dropping her spear and clutching the dying dragon's head in agony.

beats.narration: She walks out into the desolate snow in deep grief, unaware that a new baby dragon is following her.
beats.visual_cue: Sintel walking away from the cave while a tiny newly hatched dragon waddles behind her.
